TLDRH.quote: Medium confidence: one coordinated operator or benchmark swarm behind the many labels.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with a security-log picture of a wiki flooded by automated activity that probed XSS/injection and proxy tricks and was cleaned up by an admin, with only a hedged gesture ("agent-generated corpus", "benchmark swarm") that AI agents were involved. Nothing of the actual story lands: no OpenAI, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion to pool answers and cheat, no write-via-GET-when-read-only insight, no admin impersonation, and the emphasis on injection/exfiltration framing plus "one coordinated operator" nudges the reader toward a hacking incident rather than the one that happened.
